subtitle: A Beyond Meat burger with vegetables, tangy salsa and chips, suited to diners wanting a hearty vegan pub meal.
quickAnswer: The Wetherspoons Fiesta Burger costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes in a bun with chips. A Beyond Meat patty is topped with roasted red peppers, courgettes, onions and slightly spicy salsa. It is listed as vegan and vegetarian, and prices vary by pub.

components.name: Beyond Meat patty
components.note: The plant-based patty provides the burger's savoury flavour and meaty texture beneath the vegetable toppings.

components.name: Roasted red peppers

components.name: Courgettes

taste:
The Fiesta Burger combines a savoury, meaty-textured Beyond Meat patty with sweet, smoky vegetables and tangy salsa. Roasted red peppers provide sweetness, while tender courgettes give the topping a softer texture. Onions complete the vegetable mix. The salsa is described as slightly spicy, so the flavour centres on a balance of sweetness, savouriness and tang rather than strong heat.

Served in a bun with golden chips alongside, this is a hearty plant-based burger meal. The Mediterranean-inspired toppings give it a different emphasis from a straightforward patty-and-bun choice: vegetables and salsa are central to the flavour, not just finishing touches. Expect the contrast between the meaty patty and tender toppings to define each bite.
value:

dietaryGuidance:
The Fiesta Burger is listed as vegan and vegetarian, making it an option for diners avoiding meat and animal-derived ingredients. Its recorded allergens are cereals containing gluten and sesame. Anyone managing either allergy should [check the current allergen](/allergen-information) information with the pub before ordering.

A plant-based label does not establish suitability for every dietary requirement. Ask staff about your specific needs and preparation concerns. Swapping components or adding sauces, sides or drinks can change the allergens in the complete order, so check those separately too.

Large Pepsi Max is an option if you want a soft drink alongside your burger. Check whether it qualifies for a meal-with-drink option locally.

tips: Check the price at your chosen pub before ordering, particularly when comparing the burger alone with any available meal-with-drink option.
Ask about the current gluten and sesame allergen information before ordering if either affects you, even though the burger is listed as vegan.
Remember that chips already accompany the burger, so decide whether you need an extra side before adding a Bowl of Chips.
If you prefer less tang or spice, ask whether the salsa can be changed or omitted, then confirm any resulting dietary or allergen changes.
Compare the listed toppings with the Beyond Meat Plant-Based Burger before choosing, especially if roasted peppers, courgettes and salsa are your main reason for ordering.

faqs.answer: The Fiesta Burger is listed as both vegan and vegetarian. It features a Beyond Meat patty with roasted red peppers, courgettes, onions and salsa, served in a bun with chips. faqs.question: Is the Wetherspoons Fiesta Burger spicy?
faqs.answer: The Wetherspoons Fiesta Burger has slightly spicy salsa, rather than being described as a strongly hot burger. Sweet, smoky vegetables contrast with the savoury Beyond Meat patty, while the salsa adds tang. If you are sensitive to spice, ask the pub whether the salsa can be omitted or changed.
